stories.title: Jaxson Dart's coming at you from all angles: 'He's got exceptional arm talent'
stories.summary: Dart's ability to throw from different angles gives him a chance to be not just a quarterback who makes special throws but a special quarterback.

stories.title: How much weight will Donald carry in his return to the Rams with Myles Garrett out?
stories.summary: Despite the defensive tackle returning from retirement, L.A. has never doubted that he could still make an impact.

stories.title: Falcons QB Penix to make season debut Thursday vs. Packers
stories.summary: Quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will make his season debut this Thursday night when he starts against the Packers, the Falcons announced Monday.

stories.title: Bears coach says Williams week-to-week, but QB not ruled out for MNF
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is considered "week-to-week" with a right hamstring injury he sustained in a 9-3 loss to the Vikings, coach Ben Johnson said Monday afternoon.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs' Bregman has facial fractures, hopeful for postseason
stories.summary: Chicago Cubs star Alex Bregman suffered multiple facial fractures after being struck by a foul ball while standing in the on-deck circle Sunday, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.
